name: Bathyal-Lament
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by a subterranean ocean. Farther poleward, past an ancient meteor crater, the silence feels older than the soil.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Something scrubbed this biosphere clean within a geological instant. The rocks remember it as a thin black line.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the starship crash site (colony ship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
